patch_description: Revert to the 2-distinct-parameter structure that scored best (0.74), where a single "ry_a" drives all RY pre-rotations and a single "theta" drives every RZ/ZZ/XX coupling. On top of that proven backbone, add one more zero-new-parameter entangling shell: a nearest-neighbor YY ring (wires 0-1,...,7-0) that reuses "theta". Adding an orthogonal Y-basis coupling alongside the existing Z-basis (ZZ) and X-basis (XX) couplings further enriches the accessible operator algebra (approaching a fuller SU(2)xSU(2) mixing per edge), which should help increase the worst-group margin (the dominant score term) without increasing the parameter count, since the previous XX-ring addition alone already improved score from 0.73 to 0.74. This keeps n_distinct_params = 2, preserving the parameter-economy advantage while pushing the robust-separation term higher.
